{
  "summary": "Added raw_response column to store complete AI review output before parsing, with full-text search index. Fixed bugs in task creation from review findings (parameterized tag values, safe message access). Minor test import cleanup.",
  "learnings": [
    {"topic": "Database transactions", "reminder": "When storing related data (like raw_response) that depends on another operation, consider wrapping in a transaction to avoid inconsistent state if the second query fails"},
    {"topic": "Fallback handling", "reminder": "When using fallback responses, ensure the data types match - passing an object (context) where a string (rawResponse) is expected will cause runtime issues"},
    {"topic": "SQL parameterization", "reminder": "When building dynamic SQL with arrays/tags, use parameterized values ($4, $5) instead of hardcoded strings to prevent SQL injection and enable proper escaping"},
    {"topic": "Safe property access", "reminder": "Always provide fallback values for potentially undefined properties: `finding.message || finding.suggestion || finding.file || 'default'`"},
    {"topic": "Import cleanup", "reminder": "Remove unused imports during refactoring to keep code clean"}
  ],
  "issues": [
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "location": "InterReviewService.ts:201-206",
      "description": "raw_response update happens after the main update, so if it fails, the review is marked 'completed' without raw_response",
      "suggestion": "Consider wrapping both operations in a transaction"
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "location": "InterReviewService.ts:313",
      "description": "Fallback passes `context` object as rawResponse, but rawResponse should be a string",
      "suggestion": "Convert context to string with JSON.stringify(context) or use a meaningful fallback string"
    }
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Add null check for raw_response in queries that use it",
    "Consider adding a migration to backfill raw_response for existing completed reviews",
    "Add index on created_at for inter_reviews table to improve time-based queries"
  ],
  "praise": [
    "Good use of GIN index with to_tsvector for full-text search capability",
    "Proper SQL injection prevention with parameterized queries",
    "Clean separation: storing raw response before parsing allows debugging and re-parsing",
    "Improved error handling with fallback message chain"
  ],
  "overallScore": 78,
  "codeQuality": 80,
  "testCoverage": 75,
  "documentation": 70
}
